# Termina

> Termina is a free, text-based 5v5 multiplayer MOBA played in the browser through a terminal-style interface: every command is one typed line, and the game resolves every instruction at once on a 4-second cycle.

Termina is early-stage (alpha) software. You type orders (move, attack, cast, buy) instead of aiming, so reading the board matters more than reflexes. The setting is TERMINA, a cable-landing city where two crews, CHAFF and AUDIT, contest three routes. There is nothing to download: jump into a practice match against bots, or queue for ranked 5v5, quick 3v3 or 1v1.

## Learn the game

- [How to play](https://www.terminamoba.com/learn): quick start, movement, commands, targeting and the concepts that win games on the cycle clock
- [Dry Run (heroes)](https://www.terminamoba.com/cast): all 18 operators, their abilities and talent trees, with an in-browser practice console
- [Item shop](https://www.terminamoba.com/items): every item by category, with recommended builds by role
- [Lore](https://www.terminamoba.com/lore): the world of TERMINA, its districts, crews and the batch clock

## Play and compete

- [Home](https://www.terminamoba.com/): overview and entry point to practice and ranked play
- [Leaderboard](https://www.terminamoba.com/leaderboard): top players by rating for the current season
